rust_summary: the render hook point `native_world_pre_post(world)`: the world is drawn, before finishing passes (`WorldPrePost`), with bounded late world submissions through `world.draws`.
doc_summary:
the render hook point `native_world_pre_post(world)`, after world transparency and before mod or shader-pack post passes
or built-in world post/TAA, with writable world depth, camera history and frame lighting (`WorldPrePost`). Submit depth-tested world quads, lines and billboards through `world.draws`; these share the frame's 256-draw budget with the Game world drawing helpers. Bundles need `"hooks": @API:world_pre_post@`.
